_readme: Events added by hand, for programmes no crawler can reach.
WHY: pib.gov.in, meity.gov.in, sih.gov.in, cert-in.org.in and nciipc.gov.in all
refuse requests from data-centre IP ranges, so the GitHub Actions crawl is served
'Access Denied'. National programmes announced only there (Cyber Kushti, Kavach,
the Smart India Hackathon) therefore have to be entered here.
HOW: add an object to 'events' below. Only 'title' is required, but an event with
no startsAt is shown as 'Dates to be announced'. Edit this file on GitHub and the
next crawl picks it up; no code change and no redeploy is needed.
Curated entries are trusted: they skip the relevance filter and may be undated.
If the same event later appears on a crawled source, the two are merged.
Set "published": false to keep a draft here without showing it.

_schema.title: required
_schema.type: "hackathon" or "ctf"; omit to let the classifier decide
_schema.description: a paragraph students can act on
_schema.sourceUrl: where it was announced, e.g. the PIB release
_schema.organizer: e.g. Ministry of Electronics and IT
_schema.startsAt: YYYY-MM-DD or a full ISO timestamp

_example.title: Example National Cyber Security Challenge 2026
_example.description: Replace this block with a real programme. It is here only to show the shape of an entry and is not published, because "published" is false.

_example.eligibility: Students enrolled in an Indian university.
rules: At least one member must be a registered student.
